subarea: Distance edgelist launch then switch to tree
description: Load an uploaded SNP distance edgelist, launch the network, switch to Phylogenetic Tree, and confirm the tree renders.
primary_assertions: Global stats match the known uploaded counts; rendered leaf-circle count is 30; stored and rendered Newick strings are non-empty after switching to the tree view.
notes: This is the maintained distance-edgelist tree smoke baseline.

subarea: Distance matrix launch then switch to tree
description: Load an uploaded distance matrix, launch the network, switch to Phylogenetic Tree, and confirm the tree renders.
primary_assertions: Global stats match the known uploaded counts; rendered leaf-circle count is 14; stored and rendered Newick strings are non-empty after switching to the tree view.
notes: This keeps the matrix-to-tree path under maintained coverage rather than only the 2D suite.

primary_assertions: Global stats match the known uploaded counts; rendered leaf-circle count is 30; stored and rendered Newick strings are non-empty after switching to the tree view.
notes: This covers the derived-tree path from sequence-only input.

description: Load an uploaded sequence node list, launch the network, switch to Phylogenetic Tree, and confirm the tree renders.
primary_assertions: Global stats match the known uploaded counts; rendered leaf-circle count is 14; stored and rendered Newick strings are non-empty after switching to the tree view.
notes: This covers the uploaded node-list path that derives the tree from embedded sequences.

subarea: Newick launch or switch to tree
description: Load uploaded Newick data and reach an interactive Phylogenetic Tree.
primary_assertions: The tree SVG renders; leaf counts match loaded data where deterministic counts exist; export/settings flows stay interactive on the uploaded Newick path.
notes: The maintained smoke uses the AngularTesting Newick profile via launch-then-switch, while the export/settings journey continues to exercise the larger SARS fixture on the direct tree path.

description: Export the uploaded tree as a PNG image.
primary_assertions: A uniquely named PNG file is written to cypress/downloads and has non-trivial byte length.
notes: This avoids stale-download false positives by using unique filenames per run.

description: Export the uploaded tree as an SVG image.
primary_assertions: A uniquely named SVG file is written to cypress/downloads and contains an <svg root element.
notes: This keeps tree-image export under maintained uploaded-data coverage.

description: Export the uploaded tree as Newick text.
primary_assertions: The saved text matches the currently rendered tree's canonical toNewick(false) output after normalizing line endings.
notes: The earlier assertion compared against the original session string, which was a brittle test assumption rather than product behavior.

subarea: Layout mode type and leaf-label visibility on uploaded data
description: Open tree settings on uploaded data and verify key tree controls affect the rendered SVG and backing view state.
primary_assertions: Layout, mode, and type widget state updates; leaf-label visibility toggles both the model flag and rendered label visibility.
notes: This gives the tree maintained journey at least one uploaded-data settings path instead of keeping all settings coverage sample-data-only.

description: Change the global fixed node color while Phylogenetic Tree is active on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Rendered leaf-node circle fills update to the selected fixed color on the tree generated from uploaded node and distance files.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Switch Color Nodes By to an uploaded field while Phylogenetic Tree is active on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Rendered leaf-node colors diverge by category and targeted color-table edits update the intended uploaded category on the tree view.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Apply a style file and verify the tree adopts the expected layout, mode, type, colors, and branch-label settings on uploaded style-capable data.
primary_assertions: Applied widget values match expected style-file settings; rendered node colors and branch-distance labels reflect the applied style; tree layout, mode, and type state update on the active tree.
notes: Covered on the maintained style-file tree journey within the metadata-backed spec.

description: Change the leaf label field and label font size on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Rendered leaf-label text changes to the selected uploaded field and the font size updates.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Toggle leaf tooltips and change the tooltip field on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Tooltip visibility matches the setting and hovered tooltip text matches the selected uploaded field.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Toggle leaf-node visibility, change fixed leaf size, and size leaves by a variable on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Leaf-circle opacity, fixed radius, and variable-sized min/max scaling update in the rendered SVG.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

subarea: Branch distance labels branch nodes and branch size controls
description: Show branch distance labels and branch nodes, then adjust branch-label, branch-node, and branch-stroke size controls on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Rendered branch-distance label opacity and font size update; internal-node circles appear; branch-path stroke width updates.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Click a rendered tree leaf node and verify selection state propagates on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: The clicked leaf circle renders the selected stroke color and the matching node becomes selected in commonService.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Use the branch context menu to reroot, rotate, flip, or view a subtree on an uploaded tree, then restore the full tree.
primary_assertions: The current Newick differs after the mutation, restore becomes enabled, and Restore Full Tree returns the tree to its original Newick and leaf count.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick context-menu journey.

subarea: Direct file launch to tree default view on computed sources
file_types: distance edgelist; matrix; fasta; node with sequences
description: Set File Settings default view to Phylogenetic Tree before launch and confirm computed-tree inputs reach an interactive tree without hanging behind Processing Files.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files overlay clears and the tree becomes interactive on the direct-launch path for non-Newick tree-capable uploads; session-backed counts and rendered leaf counts match expected values.
notes: Covered by the maintained direct-launch regression smoke added after fixing PBG001.

subarea: Cluster color recompute after threshold change
description: Color tree nodes by Cluster, change the link threshold while Phylogenetic Tree is active on uploaded metadata-backed tree data, and verify cluster-derived colors recompute.
primary_assertions: Cluster-colored leaf nodes change to the expected new cluster colors after threshold changes and the updated threshold persists in widget state.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Adjust Horizontal Stretch and Vertical Stretch on an uploaded tree and verify the rendered geometry updates without corrupting tree membership.
primary_assertions: tree-horizontal-stretch and tree-vertical-stretch widgets update; representative leaf-position geometry moves after each stretch change; rendered leaf count stays stable.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

subarea: Newick branch-node labels visibility and size
description: On an uploaded Newick tree, show branch-node labels and change the branch-node-label font size.
primary_assertions: Branch-node label text becomes visible only on the Newick path; label font size changes to the configured value; unrelated leaf labels remain stable.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

subarea: Center Screen refit after viewport interaction
description: Pan or zoom the Phylogenetic Tree away from its baseline position, then click Center Screen and verify the view recenters.
primary_assertions: The rendered SVG transform or viewport differs after the interaction and returns close to the baseline after Center Screen; rendered leaf and branch counts remain unchanged.
notes: Covered by mutating the tree zoom transform and validating the Center Screen reset on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

subarea: External session-to-tree selection and unselect sync
description: Mutate session node.selected outside the tree and dispatch node-selected while Phylogenetic Tree is active.
primary_assertions: Selected leaf strokes update to the configured selected color for externally selected nodes; unselect clears the highlight; unrelated leaves keep their prior state.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

description: Ctrl-click multiple rendered leaf nodes and verify additive selection works, then ctrl-click again to toggle one node off.
primary_assertions: Multiple leaves remain selected simultaneously after ctrl-click; the corresponding nodes stay selected in commonService; toggling one selected leaf off clears only that node.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

description: Load a computed-tree input, switch to Phylogenetic Tree, and export PNG, SVG, and Newick from the derived tree state.
primary_assertions: Each export writes a non-empty artifact; exported Newick matches the rendered tree's canonical toNewick(false) output; export remains interactive on the computed-tree path.
notes: Covered across matrix FASTA and sequence-node-list computed-tree inputs in the maintained derived-tree export journey.

description: Change tree-specific settings, close the Phylogenetic Tree tab or switch away, then reopen the view and verify the prior tree settings are reapplied.
primary_assertions: The reopened tree honors layout mode type label visibility and other modified tree widgets from session.style.widgets; rendered geometry matches the restored state.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick controls journey.

subarea: Session save and reload round-trip for tree state
description: Change tree-specific settings on uploaded data, save a .microbetrace session, reload the app, reopen the saved session, and verify the tree state is restored.
primary_assertions: The saved session restores tree layout mode type label visibility and rendered geometry on the reopened tree.
notes: Covered on the maintained uploaded Newick session round-trip journey.

description: Export the uploaded tree as a JPEG image.
primary_assertions: A uniquely named JPEG file is written to cypress/downloads and has non-trivial byte length.
notes: Added to keep phylogenetic export format coverage aligned with other maintained visual export journeys.

description: Change the global fixed link color while Phylogenetic Tree is active on uploaded metadata-backed tree data.
primary_assertions: Rendered branch path strokes update to the selected fixed link color across the active tree.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.

description: Change the global selected color while Phylogenetic Tree is active and verify tree leaf selection styling uses it.
primary_assertions: The selected tree leaf stroke updates to the configured selected color and retains the expected selected stroke width after click selection.
notes: Covered on the maintained metadata-backed tree journey.
